title: Publish security posture runbook and admin guidance
description:
Problem: operators need explicit guidance on safe-by-default stance, opt-in exceptions, and deployment posture selection.

Desired outcome: concise, actionable runbook linked from planning and admin surfaces so security posture is understandable and repeatable.

Scope:
- In scope: documentation page and references describing default-safe posture, opt-in exceptions, compatibility overrides, and rollout checklist.
- Out of scope: full security policy legal/compliance framework.

Acceptance criteria:
- Documentation clearly states safe-by-default and opt-in exceptions in practical terms.
- Guidance includes local-first, secure-local, and remote-hardened deployment recommendations.
- Sprint and task records link to this guidance for traceability.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created to formalize security posture literature and keep the safe-by-default stance explicit for operators.
